content.short: Low-fee bridge and cross-chain swap for moving any asset between chains in about 10 seconds.
content.description: MeMe Bridge moves tokens between chains in one click, picking routes that keep gas and slippage low and confirming in under 10 seconds on average. It uses zero-knowledge proofs to validate transfers, and has handled more than 3.3 million transactions and $128 million in volume for 1.4 million wallets with no reported incidents. The app also includes swaps, gas top-ups and a contract deploy tool.
content.meta: Bridge and swap any asset across chains in about 10 seconds with MeMe Bridge, which has moved $128M for 1.4M wallets.
